name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 23 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 23 hours starting 2025-04-28, at wavelengths from 1.24 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
